files.asset: flat ASCII release basename; no arbitrary file URL

pathGrammar: [A-Za-z0-9_ ./,@+\-]+; no empty, dot or dotdot segments; asset uses same grammar without slash
textLengths: Unicode code points; exclude C0 controls below U+0020 and unpaired surrogate code points U+D800..U+DFFF

places.coordinates: integer WGS84 E7 within pack coverage

resources: Closed local PMTiles, glyphs and optional sprite only. Resolve PACK_ROOT only after all hashes verify. No imports, remote images, network URLs or style terrain model.
trust: Caller pins manifest SHA256 before parsing; every listed file is hashed before atomic publication. Data-build evidence does not establish native offline rendering/routing or physical acceptance.
